_comment: Intentional standalone .tsx entrypoints that are legitimately NOT reachable from the main import graph (e.g. a component mounted only by an external harness). Only add a path here when the file is deliberately standalone — the default fix for an orphan is to WIRE it into a route/parent, not allowlist it. Paths are repo-relative POSIX.
allow: _comment_bulkselect: shared bulk-select table SUPERSEDED by ParityTable. Its route-reachable consumers (factoring ChargebacksTable + RecoursePipelineTable) migrated to ParityTable in this PR, so the guard now sees it as orphaned. Still imported by not-yet-migrated DriversTable + FuelTransactionsTable, so ARCHIVE-not-delete (§7). Retained pending those two migrations, after which it can be removed and this entry deleted.
